actions.forward: The mob is near the screen centre but small or far away (more than 3 blocks): walk toward it.
actions.back: The mob is very close and the player is low on health: back away.
actions.turn_left: No mob is visible, or the mob is in the left part of the screen: turn left.
actions.turn_right: The mob is in the right part of the screen: turn right.
actions.attack: The mob is under the crosshair AND very close, filling a large part of the screen: swing the sword.
actions.charge: The mob is under the crosshair and 2 to 4 blocks away: step toward it and swing.
actions.shield: A skeleton, stray or pillager is aiming at the player, or a creeper is flashing nearby: raise the shield.
